description:
"Summon an expanding beam of pure sunlight to doom an enemy, dealing |cffffff4038|r Physical Damage immediately and marking them for |cffffff6|r seconds.

After the duration ends, the sunlight bursts, dealing |cffffff4469|r Physical Damage to the enemy, which increases based on the amount of damage you dealt to them over the duration, up to |cffffff200|r%.

You can have only one Power of the Light active at a time, and each hit of the ability applies the Sundered status effect."
